run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
use_dropwiki_suffix: use DropWikiSuffix to remove the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename string
use_wikibrancher_init: use WikiBrancher to initialize a wiki brancher with a dot version like 2.6
use_branchfiles: use BranchFiles to copy wiki files with an SVN version prefix using svn cp
use_updatelinks: use UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to update internal wiki links in versioned branched files
